description: Project templates for RedBase (REDB), the entity database for .NET: a console app (dotnet new redb), a Razor Pages site (redb-razor), a Blazor site (redb-blazor), an integration worker (redb-worker), an LLM chat (redb-chat), a Blazor WebAssembly app with a redb.Route API (redb-app) and a Blazor BFF with redb.Route controllers (redb-bff). Each runs as is on SQLite with Pro; the route-based ones also deploy as Tsak modules.
title: RedBase Project Templates
